Two published rules of thumb -- about 30 oz of resin per 50-inch yard of 1708, and 1.5 to 2 lb per ten square feet -- bracket 0.89 to 1.19; suppliers quote 1:1 to 1.4:1. This sits in the middle of the two. Vacuum bagging would beat it and hand layup will not
